# Central counterparty (`ccp` v1)

A clearing house with its default fund and margin model.

**Group:** Counterparty and legal · **Mnemonic:** `CCP` · **Identifiers:** `CCP-…` in `ccpId`

Open one with `CCP <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: ccp
version: 1
description: A clearing house with its default fund and margin model.
match: { kind: ccp, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Counterparty and legal · Central counterparty, id: $.ccpId }
strip:

  - { label: Default fund, bind: $.defaultFund, fmt: compact }
  - { label: IM posted, bind: $.imPosted, fmt: compact, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Model, bind: $.marginModel }
panels:

    kind: table
    title: Clearing accounts
    key: F2

    columns:
      - { label: Account, bind: "@.id" }

  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
